title: Design: the archived grid view
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new archived tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, archived.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row.
  3. Click Edit on matrix A's row.
  4. Point at a Default cell.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • A light blue notice with an info icon sits at the top of the page above the title.
  • The grid shows Cost Range, "1 Default" and tier A's name with no number; only tier A's column has a picker and boxes, as in picture 4.26.

Step 4:

  • The Default cell is outlined and a dark gray tooltip below it reads "Default prices live parts, so it can't be changed in the archived view.", as in picture 4.27.
